customer: Want to sell my brother's minivan for him, he can't get in himself. What do I need?
agent: You can sell it on his behalf if he gives you a power of attorney. Have him sign form NW-POA-1 in front of a notary, then bring that along with your own photo ID and the car's documents (see What to bring). If he has passed away, the power of attorney no longer applies, and you'd want our article Selling a car you inherited instead.
